description: This is a main package source file for the host orchestrator component of an Android Cuttlefish project. It initializes and runs an HTTP server, sets up proxy routing, and manages various orchestrator configurations.

methods.name: defaultCVDArtifactsDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory path for CVD artifacts based on the current user's UID.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on the specified address and port.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs a list of startup functions concurrently and waits for all to complete, terminating on error.

methods.name: newOperatorProxy
methods.description: Creates a reverse proxy to the operator running on a specified port.
